name: Tallow Reach
summary: The far rim, forty-one days south of Bell Harrow, and a poorer town for it: no stepped quays, just a shelf of red rock where the old sea ended and a spill of flat-roofed houses behind a wall built to stop salt, not people. It renders rather than kilns - fat, hide, rope and axle-grease - so the whole reach smells of tallow and the wind off the plain carries it twenty miles out. Crossings that arrive here arrive spent, and Tallow Reach makes its living on what a spent crossing has to sell cheap.
